# Keyboard reference

This page is generated from `KEYMAP_CATALOG` and the same help-section mapping that produces the in-app `?` overlay. It covers 498 catalog entries across 28 contexts.

Movement, text editing, and list navigation share one grammar. A binding listed under several contexts means the same key does the same kind of action there; the section heading names the surface. Bindings marked hidden from which-key hints are still listed here and still work.

| Keys | Action | Notes |

### Notes

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `h/l` | Select the column to the left or right; from chat, h selects Agents first and l selects Work. |
| `j/k` | Select the stacked pane below or above: Agents/Workspaces on the left, Work/Approvals on the right. |
| `Enter` | Enter the selected pane. Selecting a pane never starts content navigation or focuses the composer. |
| `Esc` | Leave interaction and return to pane selection. |
| `Enter` | Chat Enter enters transcript navigation; it never focuses the composer. |
| `i` | Focus the composer from chat. Esc then returns to chat interaction, and another Esc returns to selection. |
| `white / grey` | The selected or interacting pane has a white border and heading. AGENTS/WORKSPACES headings follow their own sub-pane, and Work cards are white only in Work interaction. |

### Notes

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `d` | Delegates in the work list; inside a text buffer d is the delete operator. |
| `h/j/k/l` | Focus moves to the nearest card in that direction; h/l page at the leftmost/rightmost row edge, j/k page at a vertical edge, gg/G jump first/last, and Ctrl+d/u step a half page. |
| `white / grey` | The selected Work pane has a white border; cards are white only after Enter enters Work interaction. The pane border and card focus stay separate. |
| `d/t/r/R/x/o` | Only actions valid for the focused card are advertised: active cards delegate, reassign, restart, and cancel; stalled or retrying cards also retry; failed or cancelled history cards retry or restart; replied cards stay read-only. Enter opens the durable result when the card has one. |
| `v / Enter` | Approvals live only in the right column. Split mode pins a small summary under Work; v opens the full-height inbox from any pane, Enter from the small selection opens the same inbox, j/k move, Enter resolves, and Esc returns to split mode. Closing the right pane hides approvals. |

## Composer · Insert

Context: `composerInsert`, `completion`.

### Insert

| Keys | Action | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` | Send message | — |
| `Shift+Enter` | Insert a new line | — |
| `Esc` | Go to composer Normal | — |
| `Ctrl+G` | Leave the composer immediately | — |
| `Ctrl+C` | Stop running work | — |

### Completion

| Keys | Action | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `$` | Open agent mentions | — |
| `@` | Open file references | — |
| `/` | Run a slash command | — |
| `Up` | Previous completion | — |
| `Down` | Next completion | — |
| `Enter` | Accept the completion | — |
| `Esc` | Close the completion popup | — |

### Notes

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `text` | Type at the cursor. Enter sends and keeps Insert focus; Shift+Enter adds a line. |
| `/` | At message start / lists commands plus every skill with Command, Skill \| General, or Skill \| <Owner> flags; after $Agent / it lists only that agent's assigned skills. |
| `General` | A General skill has no Skillbox owner; it routes to the leader for triage. A General skill under a non-leader mention is rejected with the leader's name so the Skillbox stays authoritative. |
| `/init` | Init is solo-only and workspace-only: send /init by itself. It appends a visible System Agent job, streams progress and a report, and never falls through to native /init. |
| `exact text` | Each addressed agent receives the exact text once per message; multiple skills for one agent group into one prompt, no per-skill bodies or tasks are created, and separate messages keep their order. |
| `validation` | Invalid skill or agent references reject the whole message before work starts, name the exact skill and owner, and keep the draft. |

## Modes and Esc ladder

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NORMAL` | Lists navigate rows; text buffers run the Vim subset. |
| `INSERT` | Type into the focused composer or text field. |
| `VISUAL / V-LINE` | Select text by character or line, then yank, cut, or change. |
| `COMMAND` | The : command line or the / search/filter input. |
| `mode` | Mode is global and persistent: focus, overlay, wizard-step, and surface changes never assign it; Enter never changes it. Only explicit mode keys do. |
| `caret` | Every text editor shows a block caret in Normal and a line caret in Insert, Visual, and Command; an unfocused editor shows none. |
| `Esc` | Insert → Normal (composer or text field). |
| `Esc` | Visual → Normal. |
| `Esc` | Composer Normal → chat interaction → pane selection. |
| `Esc` | Settings text field Normal → settings Normal. |
| `Esc` | Settings Normal → close settings. |
| `Esc` | Wizard text field Insert → field Normal; field Normal → cancel the wizard (a dirty draft asks first). |
| `Esc` | Wizard step Normal → cancel the wizard. n next and N previous move between steps; Enter advances. |
| `Esc` | Cancel the dialog, picker, confirm, or result overlay. |
| `Esc` | Command → Normal, restoring the previous filter. |
| `Esc` | Chat interaction → pane selection; a select-mode Esc clears a filter or committed search first, otherwise it is a no-op. |
| `Esc` | Esc never leaves Ensemble. Quit deliberately with :q or Space q. |
| `Ctrl+G` | Leave the focused composer, settings, wizard, or prompt text field immediately when the host consumes Esc. |

## Clipboard and mouse

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Wheel` | Scroll the scrollable pane under the pointer |
| `Drag` | Select text in the pane where the drag starts |
| `Release` | Copy the selection to the system clipboard and show a toast |
| `Double-click` | Select a word |
| `Triple-click` | Select a line |
| `Click card` | Focus that Work card |
| `Click ‹ ›` | Page the Work pane |
| `Click approval` | Focus an inline approval; click the focused row again to resolve it |
| `y / yy` | Yank to the system clipboard. |
| `d / dd / x` | Deletes are cuts and also write to the system clipboard. |
| `p / P` | Read the system clipboard first; the internal register is the fallback. |
| `Visual y / d / c` | Yank, cut, or change the selected range. |
| `async` | A paste is discarded if focus or the buffer changed while the clipboard read was in flight. |
| `toast` | Copy success clears a mouse selection; failure keeps it and shows an error. |

## Statusline legend

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `mode` | Chip: NORMAL, INSERT, VISUAL, V-LINE, or COMMAND. |
| `context` | Agents, Workspaces, Group chat, Direct conversation, Work list, Settings, Wizard, Dialog, Approvals, or Help. |
| `git:(branch*)` | Branch, dirty mark, ahead ↑, and behind ↓ counts. |
| `position` | line:col in a text buffer, row/total in a list, or percent in the transcript. |
| `chord` | Pending multi-key prefix, e.g. g. |
| `hints` | Context keys generated from the binding catalog, e.g. enter open │ / filter │ space leader. |
| `│` | Chrome joins segments with a faint │ and one space; ASCII \| is the fallback. Chat message content is never rewritten. |
| `LEADER` | The LEADER rail badge is a true cutout on an opaque surface; when no surface is guaranteed, black/white contrast is chosen from the accent. |
| `row 2` | : or / input while active; otherwise the latest transient message; otherwise blank. |

## Native-session scope

| Key or gesture | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Policy | Native-session keys are owned by the host; a hidden Ensemble page never consumes them. |
| `quit / F2` | Leaving Ensemble hides the page; native keys, including /, go to the host immediately. F2 returns to Ensemble. |

## Custom overlays not in the keymap catalog

Two read-only overlays use local key handlers instead of `KEYMAP_CATALOG`. Their keys are listed here explicitly and are not part of the in-app help coverage check.

### `:logs` viewer

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `Esc / q` | Close the viewer. |
| `r` | Refetch the current filter. |
| `j / Down` | Scroll down one row. |
| `k / Up` | Scroll up one row. |
| `PageDown / Ctrl+d` | Scroll down ten rows. |
| `PageUp / Ctrl+u` | Scroll up ten rows. |
| `g` | Jump to the top. |
| `G` | Jump to the bottom. |

### `:limits` panel

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `j / Down` | Select the next row. |
| `k / Up` | Select the previous row. |
| `h / Left` | Decrease the selected value. |
| `l / Right` | Increase the selected value. |
| `Enter / s` | Validate and save all four limits. |
| `Esc / q` | Cancel and close the panel. |

The native OpenCode host owns keys inside a native session; this page does not claim host bindings.
